purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: The viewer’s public map layer is discoverable, but the official JS routes parcel identify through an Authorization-token endpoint; direct anonymous WMS/WFS probes at the documented service path returned 404. No safe public geometry query was established. Whether BHUMI offers a public full-geometry export or service path independent of authenticated identify; registered parcel coverage at the exact WUP point is unverified.
registryAssessment: The official ATR/BPN Banyumas office handles local land registration, and the official BHUMI national interactive map advertises a registered “Bidang Tanah” layer. Banyumas Regency’s PENA MAS GIS is only a government-owned land asset inventory, not general private cadastral coverage.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official ATR/BPN BHUMI interactive-map shell (HTTP 200); public HTML loads map JS.
Official BHUMI help says the interactive map publishes ATR/BPN spatial data through the ATLAS geoportal.
Official map help describes parcel (“bidang tanah”) layer, coordinate/legend tools, and identifying a parcel using NIB/Hak/NIBEL.
Official Banyumas ATR/BPN office publication confirms the local land office and registration processes in Kabupaten Banyumas.
Banyumas Regency official PENA MAS GIS maps government-owned land assets in Purwokerto subdistricts only; not a private cadastral register.
